description: This file contains the definition of the 'Changeable' interface in the org.openmrs package, which provides methods for tracking change metadata such as who last changed an object and when.

classes.name: Changeable
classes.description: An interface for domain objects that need to track last change user and date.

methods.name: getChangedBy
methods.description: Returns the user who last changed the object.

methods.name: setChangedBy
methods.description: Sets the user who last changed the object.

methods.name: getDateChanged
methods.description: Returns the date when the object was last changed.

methods.name: setDateChanged
methods.description: Sets the date when the object was last changed.
